description:
Diagnose one public HTTP(S) URL without registration: DNS, TCP, verified TLS and HTTP HEAD.
    Only ports 80/443, no credentials/query strings/fragments or redirects. Default uses HEAD.
    Optional surface_scan=true requires surface_authorized=true: only hosts you operate or may test.
    Public scope GETs the root, discovery docs and linked JS. Verified scope also probes config files
    and sourcemaps: supply agent_id and its owner api_key with current DNS verification of that hostname.
    At most 15 URLs, 256 KiB each, 2 MiB total and 6.5 seconds extra. No remote tools or credentials
    sent to the target. Returns categories, confidence, remediation and coverage, never matched values,
    fragments, snippets or dynamic paths. Findings are candidates; no_findings is not a security certificate.
    Surface scans are point-in-time, unsigned and share the same quota; not available in scheduled watches.
    Returns cause, evidence and suggested_action. 10 attempts per IP per 24h; honor Retry-After.
    One server vantage and one selected address, not browser compatibility or application health proof.
name: diagnose_http
